summary: This function works out how many billable units a meter has used between a previous reading and a current reading, multiplied by a multiplier, and handles the meter rolling over from its maximum back to zero.

rules.text: If the current meter reading is lower than the previous reading, the meter is treated as having rolled over past 99999 back to 0. The units used are counted up to 99999, plus the readings after the roll-over, plus one, and then multiplied by the multiplier.
If the current reading is not lower than the previous reading, the units used are the difference between the current and previous readings, multiplied by the multiplier.
The number 99999 is the meter's maximum reading before it wraps back to zero, and it is used in the roll-over calculation.
When the debug flag is set to 1, the calculated units are printed to the debug output before being returned. Otherwise nothing is printed.
